LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 13.1.1 EXTENSIVE LISTENING: POEMS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.1: Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Extensive Listening: Poems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Extensive Listening: Poems, part of Strand 13 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: what stands out in presentation. 1. How can you improve the presentation of a poem? 2. What messages are conveyed in poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch recordings or performances of poems on the need for consumer protection and patriotism for enjoyment,

2. with peers, discuss the different messages in the poems,

3. discuss in groups the performance techniques that make the presentations appealing,

4. identify poems on the need for consumer protection and perform them while recording themselves,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch recordings or performances of poems on the need for consumer protection and patriotism for enjoyment,
2. with peers, discuss the different messages in the poems,
3. discuss in groups the performance techniques that make the presentations appealing,
4. identify poems on the need for consumer protection and perform them while recording themselves,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 13.1.1 Extensive Listening: Poems together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner respects the opinion of others while discussing the different messages in the

poems.

• Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner discusses what stands out in each group presentation thus enhancing performance.

Values:
Patriotism: It is fostered as the learner interacts with poems on consumer protection,

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Consumer literacy skills: They are enhanced as the learner interacts with poems on the need for consumer protection.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Reading poems on consumer protection and patriotism is related to concepts on business which are handled in Pre-Technical

Studies.
